messages:
Jasper: Hey folks — heads up that Maya's birthday is this Friday. Two quick celebration ideas: a tiny desk 'parade' with confetti + cupcakes :tada: or a low-waste potted plant + signed card :seedling:. Which do you prefer?
Felipe: Plant pls, less sugar low cleanup. Maya kills plants tho (jk). :laughing:
Erin: Confetti is fun but messy for shared desks. I'm remote that day but will send a gif.
Priya: I'm in-office Friday and can bring cupcakes if we go that route. Any allergy notes?
Mina: I'm leaning plant. Also happy to handle the card and a short message thread for remote folks to add to the card.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: quick poll — react with ✅ for plant, 🎉 for confetti+cupcakes, or 🤷 if you don't care. Poll closes Thursday 10am.
Jasper: Adding a practical note — if we do confetti, can someone bring a small vacuum/sweep kit? We don't want to leave flakes in the pods.
Felipe: Allergy FYI: Maya is okay with dairy but has a friend who's gluten-free. If we do cupcakes maybe get 1 GF option. I can pick GF mini muffins from the bakery.
Erin: If plant wins, can we do a succulent? Hard to kill + easy to ship to remote. Also I'll Venmo $5 for a card fund.
Priya: I can order succulents from the office plant vendor. Price ~ $12 each. I'll post link if people want to chip in.
Mina: Also propose a tiny virtual 5-min huddle at 3pm for singing for those remote — optional.
Jasper: OK plan: wait for emoji votes, if majority ✅ then Priya orders succulent + Mina collects messages for card; if majority 🎉 Priya & Felipe handle cupcakes (1 GF). Virtual 3pm singalong either way. I'll pin this thread and follow up with a short reminder on Thursday. Thanks all! :sparkles:
